messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-04-18] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Incident review INC-2025-011. Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13. Root cause: an index missing after the schema migration. Decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2025-10-27] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Review of INC-2025-023 (the search indexer, 2025-10-24). The root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. We decided that reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2025-07-09] incident-review/INC-2025-017: Incident review INC-2025-017. Auth-gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06. Root cause: an expired intermediate certificate. Decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
- [2025-03-11] standup/ember/2025-03-11: Policy: every the auth gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-03-06] incident-review/INC-2025-004: INC-2025-004 review. What happened: notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-03-04. Why: a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. Follow-up decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2025-12-15] handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction: The 2025-11-18 note about the indexer named the wrong team. The Dune team took it over on that date; the Ember team did not.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki.
- [2026-02-11] incident-review/INC-2026-003: Incident review INC-2026-003. The webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-08. Root cause: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
- [2026-05-22] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2025-11-17] standup/ember/2025-11-17: Team Ember saw that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it. The weekly architecture review is run by Oskar.
- [2025-09-16] standup/atlas/2025-09-16: Decision: webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys, because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.
- [2025-07-18] handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-07-01: auth-gateway went to team Boreal, not the Cinder team. Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-02-19] standup/atlas/2025-02-19: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Priya Raman for anything this cycle, not Tomasz. Priya Raman runs the quarterly capacity review.
- [2025-01-31] standup/atlas/2025-01-31: Atlas adopted a no-deploy Friday.
- [2025-09-18] standup/dune/2025-09-18-2: Farah Haddad is the release captain for Q3 2025.
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: Team Dune owns the reporting service.
- [2025-04-23] standup/ember/2025-04-23: The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.
- [2025-03-31] standup/dune/2025-03-31: Farah still has the Dune pager.
- [2025-09-15] standup/boreal/2025-09-15: Lena still has the Boreal pager.
- [2025-07-29] standup/boreal/2025-07-29: Boreal planning meeting is every Thursday. Lena Fischer is the release captain for Q1 2026.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20: For the record, image-resizer is owned by team Dune.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: Team Ember owns the job scheduler.
- [2025-08-13] standup/boreal/2025-08-13: The search indexer must stay on OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. Reminder that reporting depends on the ledger.
- [2025-05-15] standup/dune/2025-05-15-2: Reminder: the job scheduler is owned by Dune.
- [2025-01-13] standup/dune/2025-01-13: First on-call rotation for Dune goes to Farah.
